name: Little Butterfly
parts: Butterfly on an openwork flower charm
description: A butterfly at rest on an openwork flower charm, with a diamond-cut butterfly link, on an oval link chain.
description_ms: Seekor rama-rama hinggap pada charm bunga berlubang, dengan pautan rama-rama potongan berlian, pada rantai pautan bujur.
description_zh: 镂空花朵吊饰上停着一只小蝴蝶，配钻石切面蝴蝶链节，串在椭圆链节手链上。
